meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 当你就代码库提问时，Claude 会读取项目里的知识图谱文件 `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json`，先搜出相关节点，再找相连的边和所属分层，只用相关子图作答，并指到具体文件、函数和依赖关系。
howto.when: 当你想就代码库提问，或调用 `/understand-chat` 并传入查询时。若项目里没有知识图谱文件，它会提示你先运行 `/understand`。

say.text: 这个项目里用户登录是怎么实现的？
say.note: 它会去知识图谱里找相关节点和依赖

say.text: /understand-chat 订单模块依赖哪些服务？
say.note: 返回匹配节点周围的 1 跳子图

say.text: 数据库配置写在哪些文件里？
say.note: 它按配置类节点和所属分层查找

howto.what_en: When you ask about a codebase, Claude reads the knowledge graph at `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json`, greps matching nodes, follows their edges and layers, and answers from that subgraph with concrete files, functions and dependencies.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to ask questions about a codebase or call `/understand-chat` with a query. If no knowledge graph file exists, it tells you to run `/understand` first.

say_en.text: How is user login implemented in this project?
say_en.note: It finds related nodes and dependencies in the graph

say_en.text: /understand-chat which services does the order module depend on?
say_en.note: Returns the 1-hop subgraph around the matches

say_en.text: Which files hold the database config?
say_en.note: It greps config nodes and their layers
